Run `dotnet run --project tools/testing/checks/TranspositionFrontierChecks -c Release`.

Links the actual production frontier. Compares 512,000 decisions against the frozen
List algorithm, including incomparable labels, duplicate rejection, replacement,
NaN/infinities, and collapse/re-expansion. Checks 131,072 stored updates after block/dictionary growth, missing keys, replacement,
independent tables and rebuilds. Measures 100,000 retained table entries against the
frozen current singleton-object storage; this is an allocation check, not game timing.
